claims.text: The target material is a Ta-based refractory HEA with a BCC disordered-solid-solution initial state.
MTP-LCEP will reproduce DFT melting free-energy differences within 2%.
Standard EAM potentials will deviate by more than 15% for the target melting free-energy calculation.
The greater-than-15% EAM error will be caused by failure to represent liquid short-range order.
LCEP perturbs a pre-equilibrated liquid by swapping atomic species within a fixed local coordination shell.
Localized chemical perturbations can replace integration over the entire phase space.
The MTP will be trained on high-temperature AIMD liquid configurations and solid-liquid-interface configurations.
Including liquid and solid-liquid-interface configurations in training will ensure MTP transferability.
Short-range order and local coordination in multicomponent liquids are composition dependent.
Liquid short-range order and local coordination are critical to accurate free-energy estimation.
Standard EAM functional forms cannot capture complex composition-dependent electronic screening in refractory HEA liquids.
Refractory Ta-W-Cr-V alloys exhibit Cr-V clustering or segregation tendencies.
Cr-V clustering occurs in the liquid state of the target alloy.
The target refractory HEA liquid exhibits Ta-W segregation tendencies.
Higher-order MTP descriptors trained on liquid AIMD data capture subtle liquid-SRO variations.
Restricting perturbations to relevant local configuration space provides valid free-energy differences without global thermodynamic integration.
MTP-LCEP will reduce computational cost by more than a factor of 100 relative to full integration.
Negative mixing enthalpies and strong chemical interactions occur in the Ta-W-Cr-V alloy system.
The proposed method will fail for ideal liquids or when high-temperature liquid configurations are absent from the training set.
The local-perturbation free-energy scheme assumes a locally harmonic or well-behaved liquid free-energy landscape, an assumption that severe near-melting anharmonicity may violate.
